logoPrompt: Precise logo edit. The input is the official DADA logo. Preserve its EXACT custom connected angular DADA letter shapes, proportions, sculpted facets, wave-shaped bottom contours, and the EXACT two swoosh arcs above/below. Do not retype the letters. Change ONLY the palette to electric royal blue #3984ff and icy cyan #69e8ff with white/silver highlights, replacing purple, magenta, yellow and orange. The swooshes must also be blue and cyan only. Remove the dark background entirely. Return ONLY this exact logo centered with 5 percent breathing room on GENUINE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, landscape 1536x1024 or similar landscape. No stars, extra icons, scenery, text, new outlines or extra shapes. Sharp clean edges and refined dimensional metallic gradient. No outside glow or drop shadow.
